method: Every room in this survey was checked against its own official website on 2026-11-17. A row is published only where an official page or an official PDF prints the value. Where the official source publishes a schedule as images with no text, nothing is transcribed and the gap is recorded instead. Third-party schedules were found for several of these rooms and were not used. "No poker room published" means the property's own casino page lists none; it is not a statement that the room does not exist.
note: Recurring daily and weekly events at Las Vegas poker rooms other than the Venetian and Wynn. These rooms print weekday schedules, not calendar dates, so the rows carry weekdays and no date. They are kept in this file and out of data/tournaments.json, whose rows are dated.

findings.text: The official room page states four daily start times (10:10 am, 2:10 pm, 6:10 pm, 10:10 pm) and two buy-in levels ($120 and $300) without mapping one to the other. No row is built, because a row needs a buy-in and an entry rule attached to a time.

flags.title: Start times conflict inside one operator's own sources
flags.found: The official MGM Grand poker page prints "Daily Texas Hold'em Tournaments 11:00am, 7:00pm and 11:00pm". The official schedule PDF linked from that same page prints 11:10am, 7:10pm and 11:10pm.
flags.handling: Both times are kept. The rows use the schedule PDF's times, because the PDF is the document that also prints the buy-in, chips and level length for each slot. The page's times are quoted on the row.

flags.title: The weekly schedule PDF carries a month in its title
flags.found: The PDF linked as "Weekly Schedule" prints the heading "MGM Grand August Tournament Schedule" and a grid of weekday columns with no dates and no year.
flags.handling: The grid is stored as a recurring weekday schedule, not as dated rows. Which month it describes cannot be read from the document, so no date range is claimed.

flags.title: Extra chips can be bought inside the buy-in
flags.found: "Each initial $120 buy-in is allocated as follows: $92 to Prize Pool, $13 House Fee and a one-time, voluntary gratuity of $11 which grants players an extra 10,000 chips. $4 will fund Tournament Promotions." and "Players start with 25,000 tournament chips, including the chips for staff gratuity. (15,000 + 10,000)".
flags.handling: Paying $11 more takes a starting stack from 15,000 to 25,000 chips, so spending more buys an in-game advantage. These events are kept out of the single-entry list and shown in the separate section, which is what the brief asks for with events where money buys an advantage.

flags.title: The Saturday $150 event has no published structure sheet
flags.found: The official poker page links one structure sheet only, the $120 NLH. The schedule PDF prints a Saturday 11:10am "$150 NLH - $2,000" with 25K chips and 20-minute levels.
flags.handling: The row keeps the buy-in, guarantee, chips and level length printed on the schedule PDF. Its entry rule, fee split and late-registration close stay blank and unverified.

flags.title: The two MGM PDFs are hosted off the property domain
flags.found: Both PDFs are served from assets.contentstack.io, not from mgmgrand.mgmresorts.com. They are reached only through links on the official poker page.
flags.handling: They are cited as "linked from the official page", the same treatment the site already gives the Bellagio flyers (F40). No value is taken from a PDF that the official page does not link.

flags.title: The Orleans schedule PDF's file name and its printed period do not agree
flags.found: The file is named 2026_orleans_october_poker_daily_tournaments_schedule_ada.pdf, while the official page links it as "2026 Orleans Poker Daily Schedule". Nothing inside the PDF prints a month, a year or a date range.
flags.handling: The events are stored as a recurring weekly schedule with no dates. Which period the printed grid covers is not stated on the source, so no period is claimed.

flags.title: The Orleans PDF points at a dead URL
flags.found: The PDF's own footer prints: "For tournament structures or questions, contact a Poker Room staff member at 702-365-7150 or go to our website: https://www.orleanscasino.com/play/casino-games/poker-room". That URL returns "Not Found" on 2026-11-17.
flags.handling: The live official page used instead is https://orleans.boydgaming.com/play/poker-room, which is where the PDF itself is linked from.

flags.title: No Orleans daily event is single entry
flags.found: Every one of the thirteen structure sheets in the official PDF prints the same clause: "Late entries and re-entries are available until the start of Level ...". The Sunday Special additionally prints "One-Time Add-On: $100 = 25,000 Chips".
flags.handling: All thirteen Orleans rows are stored with a re-entry rule and kept out of the single-entry list.

flags.title: South Point publishes its schedule and rules as images only
flags.found: The official "Daily Tournament Schedule" page carries one schedule image and sixteen rules-sheet images with no text layer. The eight named rules sheets are $120 and $200 events; the poker-room page advertises buy-ins of "$120 and $300".
flags.handling: No South Point row is built. A row needs a buy-in and an entry rule tied to a start time, and neither can be read from an image here. The official text that does exist is quoted on this page instead.

flags.title: Horseshoe confirms six daily tournaments and publishes nothing else about them
flags.found: "Test your luck with 6 exciting tournament times daily." No time, buy-in, guarantee or structure appears on the official page, and no schedule PDF was found on caesars.com.
flags.handling: Horseshoe is listed as a room with tournaments and no published schedule. Third-party schedules for it were found and deliberately not used.

flags.title: No live poker room is published for Paris, Luxor, Excalibur, SAHARA, Resorts World, Fontainebleau, The STRAT or the Mirage site
flags.found: Each property's own casino page was read on 2026-11-17 and lists no live poker room. Absence from an official page is weaker evidence than a printed statement, so these are recorded as "no poker room published", not as "no poker room".
flags.handling: They are listed in the survey with the page read, and no rows are invented for them.

flags.title: The MGM poker hub links two properties to pages that publish no poker room
flags.found: The hub lists "Luxor Poker Tournaments" with a link to luxor.mgmresorts.com/en/casino/table-games.html and "Excalibur Poker Tournaments" with a link to excalibur.mgmresorts.com/en/casino/poker-room.html, which redirects to excalibur.mgmresorts.com/en/casino.html. Neither page lists a live poker room.
flags.handling: Both properties are recorded as "no poker room published", with the hub link and the page it resolves to.

flags.title: No walking record exists for these rooms yet
flags.found: The site's walking table covers twelve hotel-to-poker-room pairs, all of them to the Venetian and Wynn poker rooms. No routed walking time was produced on 2026-11-17 from any hotel to MGM Grand, the Orleans or South Point.
flags.handling: Walking cells for these rooms are blank and flagged. Producing them is logged as a request for the integration session in COORDINATION.md; none is estimated here.
